problems: hierarchy: data/colonies.csv row 213 'habesh-eyalet,muhammad-ali-dynasty,1834,1864,... low' (and rows 212 and 214 around it): habesh-eyalet is drawn in Egypt's tint for 1834-1864. Habesh Eyalet page: 'he received the administration of Habesh in 1813'; Habesh 'reverted to Ottoman rule in 1827'; 'Massawa and Sawakin were given to him again in 1846, until his death in 1849'. So the Ottoman row should run to 1845, Egypt only 1846-1849, Ottoman again 1850-1872 (only the Hejaz coast, held by Egypt 1833-1840, would justify a 1834-1840 Egyptian row, and the dossier's keyframe covers the African coast too). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Habesh_Eyalet

gazetteer: region 'Hasa' (alias of Al-Ahsa) resolves to the whole Ash Sharqiyah province, 2,447 cells reaching 17 N (the Empty Quarter), not the oasis and Qatif; it is used by emirate-of-nejd /ledger/2 and /4, muhammad-ali-dynasty /ledger/18 and the 1839 keyframe. keyframe_overrides/0 cuts it for 1839; the ledger uses are caught by Nejd's own keyframe snap. A tighter region definition would fix all of them.
